cohort: 176 pregnant women with BMI <25 kg/m2 and 166 pregnant women with BMI >=25 kg/m2
finding: Maternal obesity (BMI >=25 kg/m2) was significantly associated with increased risk of gestational hypertension, GDM, preeclampsia/eclampsia, prolonged labor, and emergency LSCS.
mod_finding: More than half (53%) of pregnant women with BMI >=25 kg/m2 had emergency LSCS.
birth_weight: Only 0.6% of pregnant women with BMI >=25 kg/m2 had newborns weighing >4 kg.
